scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexovet/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @nexovet/api" "npm run dev -w @nexovet/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexovet/shared && npm run build -w @nexovet/api && npm run build -w @nexovet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexovet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexovet/shared && npm run test -w @nexovet/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests docs *.json *.ts compose.yaml .github/workflows/application.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests docs *.json *.ts compose.yaml .github/workflows/application.yml
